Autoregulation in Powerlifting

Autoregulation lets lifters adjust load and volume based on daily readiness. A common implementation uses RPE (Rate of Perceived Exertion) to target a specific proximity-to-failure instead of a fixed percentage of 1RM.

Key findings from recent research: percentage-based training and RPE-based training produce comparable strength gains when volume is matched, but RPE may be more forgiving on low-readiness days. See: Helms et al. 2018.

Practical tip: beginners should build a base of technique before adopting autoregulation, because self-assessed RPE accuracy improves with training age.
